receiptAndPublicationCadence: observed as latency evidence; not a hard V8 provider receipt SLA

strictScheduler.groupPhaseReservationFormula: sum(exchangeEnvelope + 500 ms terminal fence) + 1000 ms static inter-group reserve

measurementContract: requestSeconds includes eligible dispatch, IPC, transport callbacks and durable completion; processing includes local preflight, deferral publication and authorization work excluding the measured limiter sleep; waiting is reported separately; httpSeconds is the worker exchange latency
manifestProof: local loopback measurement bound to the live-v8 contract; it does not establish provider acceptance
candidateEnvelopeSource: evidence-bound V8 loopback contract; every steady sample must remain within these envelopes
admissionMode: 10 matches under measurement; temporal admission is calculated separately from measured envelope validity
rollingWindowDefinition: requestedAt in (t-window,t], all samples including initialization; sub-hour run does not prove a saturated full hour
